summary: A Sporting News guide to golf betting in the US in 2023. It reviews top sportsbook apps (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars), explains how to download and use a betting app, and lists common golf bet types and live betting. It also gives the 2024 PGA Tour schedule and covers betting on the Masters, other majors, and team events like the Ryder Cup and Presidents Cup.
one_line: Guide to the best US golf betting apps, bet types, live betting, the 2024 PGA Tour schedule, and betting on majors and team events.
key_facts: DraftKings Sportsbook offers golf markets for PGA Tour events and majors, including tournament winners, top 5, 10 and 20 finishes, matchup betting, and live betting on individual holes and shots.
FanDuel Sportsbook offers top-20 finishes, head-to-head matchups, and first-round leaders, and covers the DP World Tour and the Ryder Cup.
BetMGM Sportsbook offers event winners, top finishers, hole-in-one props, and live betting for golf.
Caesars Sportsbook offers winning margin, top finishes, and live betting props, and is known for its strong selection of bets and live betting interface.
To use a betting app in the US, you must be within the state where the app is licensed and meet the legal age requirement, often 21 years old.
Apps can be downloaded from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android), or directly from the sportsbook's official website if unavailable in the store.
Each-way bets are dual bets: one part on the golfer to win outright and the other for them to finish within a set range of places, often top 5 or top 10.
Other golf bet types include head-to-head, first-round leader, top 10/top 20, matchup, group matchup, nationality, and prop bets such as a hole-in-one.
Live golf odds are set by continually evaluating player performance alongside course dynamics, prevailing weather, and player stamina.
The PGA Tour reverts to a calendar-year schedule in 2024 for the first time since 2012, with 36 events starting in January and eight signature events.
The 2024 FedEx Cup Champion will receive $25 million.
The 2024 schedule includes The Masters (April 11-14), PGA Championship at Valhalla (May 16-19), U.S. Open at Pinehurst (June 13-16), and the Olympics (July 29-Aug. 4).
For Masters betting, key stats are driving distance, accuracy, and greens in regulation; Augusta National favors accuracy and precise approach shots, so strong iron players may be preferred.
Ryder Cup and Presidents Cup bets include the winning team, individual match outcomes, and props like which team makes more birdies or the best-dressed team captain.
